mapper.sql: (#{superAdmin}=TRUE OR NOT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM engineering_project_repositories hidden JOIN repositories hidden_repo ON hidden_repo.id=hidden.repo_id WHERE hidden.project_id=p.id AND hidden_repo.deleted_at IS NULL AND hidden_repo.owner_account_id<>#{accountId} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repository_permissions permission WHERE permission.repo_id=hidden.repo_id AND permission.account_id=#{accountId}) ))
mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.name,p.description,p.created_by,p.version,p.created_at,p.updated_at FROM engineering_projects p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC,p.id
SELECT p.id,p.name,p.description,p.created_by,p.version,p.created_at,p.updated_at FROM engineering_projects p WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL AND
SELECT id,name,description,created_by,version,created_at,updated_at FROM engineering_projects WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT membership.project_id,membership.repo_id repository_id,repository.name repository_name, membership.service_name FROM engineering_project_repositories membership JOIN repositories repository ON repository.id=membership.repo_id WHERE membership.project_id=#{projectId} AND repository.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY membership.normalized_service_name,membership.repo_id

SELECT id,project_id,contract_key,name,provider_repo_id,consumer_repo_id, provider_snapshot_id,consumer_snapshot_id,provider_evidence_path,consumer_evidence_path, provider_content_fingerprint,consumer_content_fingerprint,created_at,updated_at FROM engineering_project_contracts WHERE project_id=#{projectId} ORDER BY normalized_contract_key,id
mapper.update: UPDATE engineering_projects SET deleted_at=#{now},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.select: SELECT chunk.snapshot_id,chunk.file_path,chunk.start_line,chunk.content_hash FROM code_chunks chunk JOIN repositories repository ON repository.id=chunk.repo_id WHERE chunk.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND chunk.snapshot_id=repository.current_snapshot_id AND chunk.file_path=#{filePath} ORDER BY chunk.start_line,chunk.end_line,chunk.id

SELECT DISTINCT project.id project_id,source.repo_id source_repository_id, target.normalized_service_name target_service_name FROM engineering_projects project JOIN engineering_project_repositories target ON target.project_id=project.id JOIN engineering_project_repositories source ON source.project_id=project.id JOIN repositories source_repository ON source_repository.id=source.repo_id WHERE project.deleted_at IS NULL AND target.repo_id=#{targetRepositoryId} AND source_repository.deleted_at IS NULL AND( source_repository.owner_account_id=#{actorId} OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repository_permissions permission WHERE permission.repo_id=source.repo_id AND permission.account_id=#{actorId}) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM accounts account WHERE account.id=#{actorId} AND account.role='SUPER_ADMIN')) ORDER BY project.id,source.repo_id

SELECT contract.project_id,contract.id contract_id,#{targetRepositoryId} target_repository_id, CASE WHEN contract.provider_repo_id=#{targetRepositoryId} THEN contract.provider_evidence_path ELSE contract.consumer_evidence_path END target_evidence_path, contract.provider_repo_id,contract.provider_evidence_path,contract.provider_content_fingerprint, contract.consumer_repo_id,contract.consumer_evidence_path,contract.consumer_content_fingerprint FROM engineering_project_contracts contract JOIN engineering_projects project ON project.id=contract.project_id AND project.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE (contract.provider_repo_id=#{targetRepositoryId} OR contract.consumer_repo_id=#{targetRepositoryId}) AND( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM accounts account WHERE account.id=#{actorId} AND account.role='SUPER_ADMIN') OR( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repositories provider WHERE provider.id=contract.provider_repo_id AND provider.deleted_at IS NULL AND(provider.owner_account_id=#{actorId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM repository_permissions permission WHERE permission.repo_id=provider.id AND permission.account_id=#{actorId}))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM repositories consumer WHERE consumer.id=contract.consumer_repo_id AND consumer.deleted_at IS NULL AND(consumer.owner_account_id=#{actorId} OR EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM repository_permissions permission WHERE permission.repo_id=consumer.id AND permission.account_id=#{actorId}))) ) ) ORDER BY contract.project_id,contract.id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_cards card JOIN engineering_project_repositories membership ON membership.repo_id=card.repo_id WHERE membership.project_id=#{projectId} AND card.publication_status<>'ARCHIVED' AND( jsonb_array_length(card.scope_payload->'repositoryIds')>0 OR jsonb_array_length(card.scope_payload->'serviceNames')>0 OR jsonb_array_length(card.scope_payload->'contractIds')>0)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engineering_project_repositories membership JOIN engineering_projects project ON project.id=membership.project_id WHERE membership.repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND project.deleted_at IS NULL
